lines.text: What did you do when you got to the garden sale?
lines.speaker: Xiu

lines.text: First, I looked at the plants by the gate.
lines.speaker: Raj

lines.text: Did you buy any plants there?
lines.speaker: Xiu

lines.text: Yes. Then I bought two small plants for my desk.
lines.speaker: Raj

lines.text: Where did you go after that?
lines.speaker: Xiu

lines.text: After that, I helped my friend at her table.
lines.speaker: Raj

lines.text: Did you stay until the end of the sale?
lines.speaker: Xiu

lines.text: Yes. Finally, we packed the boxes and went home.
lines.speaker: Raj
